name: Aetheric Amplifier
oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{4}, {T}: Choose one. Activate only as a sorcery.
• Double the number of each kind of counter on target permanent.
• Double the number of each kind of counter you have.
blocked_sentences: • Double the number of each kind of counter you have

needs.what: an op (or a `player` option on double_counters) that, for each kind of counter a player has (poison, energy, experience, rad, ticket, ...), gives that player that many more of the same kind, as a placement so counter replacements and counter-placed triggers see it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: double_counters reads only permanents' counters through `objects` (and the loader refuses it without objects); add_poison and add_energy each name one fixed kind and there is no value reading a player's count of an arbitrary counter kind, so writing poison+energy by hand would silently drop experience and every other player counter kind
